Astroturfing is a campaign that presents artificial support as spontaneous grassroots backing. Astroturfing disguises the true sponsors of a message, so the audience cannot tell that the enthusiasm is manufactured. Astroturfing can be carried out with fake accounts, bots, or paid promoters posing as ordinary community members.

Bait and Switch Scam begins with an attractive offer that lures people in. Bait and Switch Scam changes the terms or delivers a different product after the victim has committed funds. Bait and Switch Scam relies on the victim having no practical way to reverse the transaction once the switch occurs.

Bear Trap is a false signal in which the price appears to be falling. Bear Trap induces traders to open short positions just before the price reverses upward. Bear Trap causes losses for those who acted on the apparent downward move.
